description: Arizona: Maricopa County Assessor sources for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/data-policy.md and the review record in docs/registry/sources/az-maricopa-assessor.md.

sources.license: Public record (A.R.S. Title 39, ch. 1); no license stated. The Data Downloads page carries only a disclaimer/indemnification ('User accepts responsibility for unauthorized use or transmission of any such data or information in its actual or altered form') and the ArcGIS Hub items carry a 'custom' license that is the same disclaimer. Commercial use of Arizona public records requires a stated commercial purpose (A.R.S. 39-121.03); the Assessor's FAQ says commercial users are responsible for complying and provides a Commercial Purpose Public Record Request form (FOR-025)
sources.redistribution: Not addressed for the free downloads (the 2002 data-sharing policy forbids commercial distribution, but it applies to data given to other government agencies, not to the public downloads); public record. Unclear until the commercial-purpose statement is filed
sources.notes: Not verified because of a legal gate, not a technical one: the downloads are free, need no account or click-through, and the files above were confirmed by a real download on 2026-11-02 (Secured_Master.zip 109,092,436 bytes, Commercial_Master.zip 26,815,873 bytes, Apartment_Master.zip 359,535 bytes; www.arcgis.com answers with a Content-Disposition name and a 302 to a signed S3 URL). A.R.S. 39-121.03 makes a person who obtains a public record for a commercial purpose without stating it liable for treble charges; clearing the gate needs the Assessor's Commercial Purpose Public Record Request form (https://mcassessor.maricopa.gov/file/data_sales/Commercial-Purpose-Public-Record-Request.pdf) with AssessorDataSales@maricopa.gov naming the registry's purpose, then set verified=true. robots.txt: mcassessor.maricopa.gov disallows only /mcs/ and search queries; data-maricopa.opendata.arcgis.com sets Crawl-delay 60 (the collector honours it) and disallows /sites/, /admin/ and the like, not /datasets/; www.arcgis.com has no rules. The Hub 'about' pages are JavaScript-rendered, so the ArcGIS item JSON (owner MaricopaAssessorGIS) is used as the landing page; the Hub API equivalent is https://data-maricopa.opendata.arcgis.com/api/v3/datasets/<id>. Secured_Master.zip holds Data/Secured_Master_BK100..BK500.txt (pipe-delimited, header row, 39 columns, one file per parcel-book series) and File Spec/Secured Master.pdf; it is updated twice a month and the item's 'modified' timestamp is the as-of date. Pass Commercial_Master.zip and Apartment_Master.zip to the adapter for building floor areas. The arcgis.com file host is slow for the collector (about 1 MB/min on 2026-11-02 with other downloads running), so a full snapshot takes an hour or more.
